actual_checks: Full exact scientific inputs, report and full earlier attempt read. Earlier announced general/quadric claim is not verified by this report. The substantive established scope is every smooth Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of a closed connected symplectically aspherical manifold, including degenerate ones, for each fixed ground field.

Both omega and c1 vanish on pi2 as required. The source explicitly fixes arbitrary ground field F, with Z2,Q,C examples; Poincare duality identifies its homological intersection cup-length cl with ell_F+1. Both conventions are stated numerically in the report.

For fixed smooth generating H, uniqueness of the Hamiltonian trajectory assigns at most one contractible periodic orbit to each fixed point. Omega|pi2=0 makes its capped action independent of cap. Therefore N fixed points give at most N action values and, by spectrality including degeneracy, at most N spectral values.

If N<ell+1, Theorem 1.4 makes the fixed set homologically nontrivial in a positive degree in every neighborhood. A finite set has disjoint coordinate-ball neighborhoods with zero positive homology, contradiction. Infinite fixed sets satisfy the finite bound immediately. Products of k positive-genus oriented surfaces have pi2=0 and cup-length ell=2k over every field, giving 2k+1. No action/fixed-point correspondence is assumed for general Hamiltonian homeomorphisms.
